const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _req_z = try std.heap.c_allocator.dupeZ(u8, "{\"max_tokens\":50,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_req_z);
    const _req_handle = liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_request_from_json(_req_z.ptr);
    if (_req_handle == 0) return error.RequestConversionFailed;
    defer liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_request_free(_req_handle);
    const _stream_handle = liter_llm.c.literllm_default_client_chat_stream_start(_client._handle, _req_handle);
    if (_stream_handle == 0) return error.StreamStartFailed;
    defer liter_llm.c.literllm_default_client_chat_stream_free(_stream_handle);
    while (true) {
        const _chunk = liter_llm.c.literllm_default_client_chat_stream_next(_stream_handle);
        if (_chunk == 0) {
            if (liter_llm.c.literllm_last_error_code() != 0) return error.StreamReadFailed;
            break;

        defer liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_chunk_free(_chunk);
